svg.aria-label: Venator search and rescue concept: an operator fences a search area, a coverage path is planned inside it, the view tilts to show 40 m of altitude, the aircraft sweeps the area and deviates around an obstacle, finds one person who is not moving and raises an emergency over 915 MHz LoRa, finds a second who is moving and follows, then returns home. Detection, follow, upload and RTL are bench-tested against mocks; the fence, the planner, the obstacle deviation and the still-versus-moving call are not built.
svg.title: Venator — search and rescue (concept)
svg.text: Fence an area, sweep it, find who is in it, come home — the system as designed

g.text: operator fences the search area · no geofence in the repo yet
coverage path planned to cover the box · no planner built
WP_BEGIN{n} → WP{i,lat,lon,alt} each ACKed → WP_END → 0 < alt ≤ 50 m → CONFIRM → ARMED
AUTO.TAKEOFF → 40 m · the plan is a surface, not a line
AUTO.MISSION · sweeping the area · OAK-D looking down
obstacle ahead → deviating · Phase 6, not started
person detected, not moving → hold station · posture is not something the detector reports
person detected, moving → OFFBOARD follow, keep 3 m · Mission 2
ALERT{person, x, y, static} → 915 MHz SF7 → ground station
AUTO.RTL → home · the track and the detections land with the operator
Concept. Detection, follow, upload, the arm gate and RTL are built and bench-tested against mocks.The fence, the planner, the deviation and the still-vs-moving call are not. Outdoor flight pending.
